title: Spicy Syrian Stew
description: A flavorful and aromatic stew originating from the Indian subcontinent, made with a medley of spices and tender meat.
instructions: Heat oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add the aromatic and sauté until fragrant.
Add the sweet and red peppers and sauté for 3-4 minutes.
Add the stew (chickpeas) and stir well.
Add the Syrian spice mix and stir well.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer for 15-20 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot garnished with fresh cilantro (if desired).
